(adrenotools_libs): libadrenotools.so and the hooks libhook_impl.so, libmain_hook.so, libfile_redirect_hook.so, libgsl_alloc_hook.so, which the APK
carries with a custom Vulkan driver (porter port --vulkan-driver; gfx_vk_core.c vk_init DM_VK_DRIVER). The CMake files are not kept.
